name: Classic Wood
description: Warm weathered wood with restrained aged-brass navigation marks.
notes: All layers use a centered 512 x 512 RGBA canvas. Every texture except the ring is optional; a missing one falls back to primitive geometry with identical motion, so a partial skin degrades in appearance only. The centred canvas is what lets the wind rune orbit outside the rim through the same rotation transform every other layer uses.

orientationConventions.model: North-up, and a normal compass: ONE moving pointer read against a fixed graduated card. The card is the ring and never rotates; the pointer is the character arrow. There is no separate north needle - north is printed on the card.
orientationConventions.ring: The dial face. A FIXED frame - it never rotates, not even in a storm. North is at 12 o'clock in the source texture and stays there, so the baked N/E/S/W marks can never tilt. Keep it subordinate: it is the background the pointers are read against.
orientationConventions.cameraWedge: Optional. A quiet background sector showing where the camera looks, drawn around the canvas centre and pointing to 12 o'clock at bearing 0. Keep it low-contrast; it must not compete with the character arrow. Omit the key and the mod draws two faint edge ticks instead.
orientationConventions.characterArrow: Optional. THE needle of this compass, and its only moving pointer. It shows which way the CHARACTER faces, not north. Tip points to 12 o'clock at bearing 0, mounted at the canvas centre. Make it the boldest thing on the dial. Omit the key for a primitive arrow.
orientationConventions.windGust: Optional. A SMALL gust rune that orbits OUTSIDE the rim, sitting on the quarter the wind comes FROM - the way a nor'easter is named for where it blows from. Draw it centred on its own canvas; the mod offsets it to the orbit radius, so the art needs no knowledge of where the rim is. Keep it well under the character arrow's visual weight, roughly a third. Wind never suffers storm interference: the instrument fails, the weather you can see does not.
orientationConventions.windPointer: Superseded. The centre-mounted wind pointer was replaced by the external orbiting gust rune; this key is still read but nothing mounts it. Use windGustTexture.
orientationConventions.lubberMarker: Superseded. Under north-up there is no fixed lubber line - the character arrow carries facing. Use characterArrowTexture.
